description: Discovered by real gateway->NotifyPerson->EmailBridge->Swoosh Test adapter test. Email is delivered but NotifyPerson output validation rejects thread_metadata string key threading (expected atom map key); gateway invalidates code and returns delivery_failed. Preexisting independent receipt contract bug, outside approved OTP polish schema scope. Reproduce with email_html_delivery fixtures and actual gateway; fix generic contract without auth/channel-specific branching, then assert sent descriptor plus HTML strong/em and usable OTP.

comments.text: Red regression: isolated MIX_TEST_PARTITION=_zaq_5r5, 1 property + 10 tests, 7 expected failures. Real Swoosh email received before Jido InvalidInputError (thread_metadata threading key expected atom); gateway challenge invalidated after delivery. Installed Jido.Action.Schema.validate_nimble calls NimbleOptions directly; NimbleOptions :map aliases {:map,:atom,:any}, supported {:map,:any,:any} preserves opaque maps and rejects nonmaps.
